current_threat_window.description: Top and recent events are limited to the current rolling threat window.

exact_day_availability.rule: A missing historical snapshot is represented as null, never as a synthetic zero-event day.

index_method.daily: Recomputed from scored events published on each UTC calendar day using the v3.2 Operational / Early Warning / Threat Index method.
index_method.rolling: Recomputed from scored events inside the 14 UTC calendar-day window ending on each history date using the same v3.2 index method as the current KPI.
index_method.operational_index: Average of the five highest scoring incident/activity events.
index_method.early_warning_index: Average of the eight highest scoring indicator events.
index_method.threat_index: 80% Operational Index + 20% Early Warning Index when operational events exist; otherwise the Early Warning Index.
index_method.assessment_handling: Assessment events are counted but do not contribute to either component index.

methodology.model: Event-based rule-driven OSINT threat intelligence model.
pipeline: Verified historical exact-day v3.2 index reconstruction
Exact-day snapshot and 7-day matrix are generated by separate pipeline stages

time_semantics.exact_day: One UTC calendar day; generated outside this dashboard-data script.
time_semantics.seven_day_matrix: Seven separate exact-day snapshots; generated outside this dashboard-data script. Missing historical day is not zero.
time_semantics.history: Long-term historical archive; retention is independent of the current threat window.

history_model.daily_activity: Exact calendar-day Threat Index reconstructed from scored events published on that date using v3.2.
history_model.rolling_threat: Fourteen-day rolling Threat Index reconstructed from scored events ending on each calendar date using v3.2.
history_model.historical_database: Long-term daily history is preserved independently of the rolling calculation window.

current_event_model.top_events: Highest-scoring events published inside the current 14-day rolling threat window.
current_event_model.recent_events: Most recently published events inside the current 14-day rolling threat window.
current_event_model.historical_events: Older events remain available in the scored dataset and historical database but are not presented as current top threats.

event_subtypes.incident: Reported operational event such as drone incident, cyberattack, sabotage, border event or GPS interference.
event_subtypes.activity: Security or military activity shaping the threat environment.
event_subtypes.assessment: Strategic, institutional or analytical background. It is not counted into the operational threat index.

methodology.warning: This dashboard is an OSINT monitoring aid. It does not confirm attribution and should not be treated as an official threat assessment.
